entry.summary: Stop letting a shared staging environment bottleneck your deployments. This guide, originally published on devopsstart.com, shows you how to implement a shift-left strategy using ephemeral Kubernetes namespaces. When five different developers deploy five different versions of a microservice to the same namespace, you aren't testing your code; you're testing your ability to manage chaos. entry.title: From 0 to 1M Impressions: Building a Niche Compiler Blog
entry.summary:
I’ve been working on a niche site focused on compilers and systems: https://www.compilersutra.com Recently, I checked my performance over the last 12 months — and the results surprised me: 1.09M impressions All of this came purely from organic search. 💡 What worked for me Picking a niche most people ignore Compilers, low-level systems, and ML compilers aren’t “mainstream” topics. But that’s exactly why they work. Less noise → more authority over time. Writing for depth, not just keywords Instead of chasing trends, I focused on: Explaining concepts deeply Consistency over intensity No crazy posting schedule. Just consistent effort over time. That’s what compounds. Structured content > random blogs I started thinking in terms of: Learning paths Instead of isolated articles. 📈 What I’m focusing on next
If you’re interested in: Compilers Check it out 👉 https://www.compilersutra.com Would love your feedback and suggestions!

entry.title: 🌳 Watering the Bonsais

It was one of those problems everyone agreed needed to be fixed. “Probably a week of work.” One Friday afternoon, I had a few hours between tasks—too late to pick up anything substantial, too early to call it a day.
